name: Weather Tab
description: Beautiful weather in every new tab. Customize forecasts, radar, and backgrounds. Search using your browser’s default engine.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; connect-src https://weatherextension.com; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; frame-src https://weatherextension.com; base-uri 'self'
